title: Does an electrode on the brain's output tract flag drugs earlier than a planar array? (SIMULATED)
status: registered before any recording of descending neurons as an electrode array was made
origin: post-round-1 review (Investigation B): the fly's neck connective, where descending neurons carry the brain's output to the nerve cord, is nature's microchannel; instrumenting it might reveal circuit failure a planar array misses
seen_before_registration: all results of the parent sweep, its replication and confirmation, the false-alarm and shift checks, and the precision table (planar array firing-rate change at behavioural onset: 0.124-0.304 log2 on FlyWire)
real untreated noise q95: Kapucu controls 0.156 log2; EPA acute screen firing-rate hit cutoff 70.97 (about -1.78 log2)

design.recordings: the parent's spontaneous recordings re-simulated with the parent's seeds (100-102, 10 s, background 5 mV); behaviour onset taken from the parent sweep, not re-run
design.planar_array: the parent's array (8 single-unit electrodes per neuropil, seed 0)
design.planar_64: 64 electrodes drawn at random (seed 1) from the planar array: the equal-count comparison
design.tract_64: 64 single-unit electrodes drawn at random (seed 2) from descending neurons (FlyWire super_class 'descending')
design.noise: 12 untreated recordings (seeds 1000-1011), random 3-vs-3 splits, as fly.checks
design.threshold: 0.156 log2 change in firing rate (Kapucu control q95), the same for every array

T0_planar_reproduces.statement: The re-simulated planar array reproduces the parent sweep's firing-rate deltas
T0_planar_reproduces.test: max |difference| of delta log2 mfr over the 21 conditions <= 0.001 (same seeds, deterministic)

T1_tract_moves_more_at_onset.statement: At the first dose that impairs behaviour, the tract array's firing rate has moved more than the equal-count planar array's
T1_tract_moves_more_at_onset.test: tract |delta log2 mfr| > planar_64 |delta log2 mfr| at behavioural onset in at least 4 of the 5 families

T2_tract_is_not_noise.statement: The tract array's firing rate is quiet when nothing is applied

T3_tract_flags_in_time_more_often.statement: At the real-chip threshold, the tract array flags more families no later than behaviour than the equal-count planar array does
T3_tract_flags_in_time_more_often.test: families flagged at or before behavioural onset: tract > planar_64

reporting: Every prediction with its value and pass/fail, whichever way it falls.
